40004895.author: पदार्थः
40004895.content: भरते Bharata, स्वप्नं about the dream, ब्रुवति while relating, क्लान्तवाहना: men with their vehicles (horses) weary, दूताः messengers, असह्यपरिखम् impassable moat, रम्यम् lovely, राजगृहम् Rajagriha, पुरम् city, प्रविश्य having entered, राज्ञा च with Kekaya king, राजपुत्रेण with king's son, Yuddhajit, समागम्य having met, अर्चिताः were honoured, राज्ञः king's,पादौ feet, गृहीत्वा having touched with reverence, तं भरतम् addressing that Bharata, वचः words, ऊचुः.told.

40004895.author: Translation
40004895.content: While Bharata was relating his dream, the mounted messengers (from Ayodhya) with their weary horses entered the lovely city of Rajagriha  surrounded by an impassable moat. There they met the king of Kekaya country and his son, Yuddhajit and were received with honour. Touching the feet of the king with reverence, they  said to Bharata:

40004896.author: पदार्थः
40004896.content: भरते Bharata, स्वप्नं about the dream, ब्रुवति while relating, क्लान्तवाहना: men with their vehicles (horses) weary, दूताः messengers, असह्यपरिखम् impassable moat, रम्यम् lovely, राजगृहम् Rajagriha, पुरम् city, प्रविश्य having entered, राज्ञा च with Kekaya king, राजपुत्रेण with king's son, Yuddhajit, समागम्य having met, अर्चिताः were honoured, राज्ञः king's,पादौ feet, गृहीत्वा having touched with reverence, तं भरतम् addressing that Bharata, वचः words, ऊचुः.told.

40004896.author: Translation
40004896.content: While Bharata was relating his dream, the mounted messengers (from Ayodhya) with their weary horses entered the lovely city of Rajagriha  surrounded by an impassable moat. There they met the king of Kekaya country and his son, Yuddhajit and were received with honour. Touching the feet of the king with reverence, they  said to Bharata:

40004897.author: पदार्थः
40004897.content: पुरोहितः the family priest (Vasistha), त्वाम् about your, कुशलम् welfare, प्राह enquired, सर्वे  all, मन्त्रिणश्च counsellors also, त्वरमाणः च immediately, निर्याहि you may return, त्वया by you,  आत्ययिकम् urgent matter, कृत्यम्  to be attended.

40004897.author: Translation
40004897.content: The family priest (Vasistha) and all the counsellors have enquired about your welfare. You must return immediately. There is an urgent matter to be attended by you.

40004898.author: पदार्थः
40004898.content: विशालाक्ष largeeyed one, (Bharata), इमानि these, महार्हाणि precious, वस्त्राणि raiments, आभरणानि च ornaments, प्रतिगृह्य having accepted, मातुलस्य to your maternal uncle, दापय give, विशालाक्ष O largeeyed one (Bharata)

40004898.author: Translation
40004898.content: Oh largeeyed one (Bharata) you are asked to take these excellent raiments and precious ornaments and bestow them on your maternal uncle (said the messengers).

40004899.author: पदार्थः
40004899.content: नृपात्मज O prince Bharata, अत्र among this, विंशतिकोट्यः twenty crore, नृपतेः for the king, तथैव च similarly, सम्पूर्णाः complete, दशकोट्यस्तु ten crores, ते to your, मातुलस्य to be given to your maternal uncle.

40004899.author: Translation
40004899.content: O prince these gifts worth twenty crore are intended for the king and the rest of the gifts worth ten crore for your maternal uncle.

40004900.author: पदार्थः
40004900.content: सुहृज्जने the relatives and friends, स्वनुरक्तः who is very affectionate, भरतः Bharata, तत् that, सर्वम् all, प्रतिगृह्य having received, तान् दूतान् those messengers, कामैः what they liked, सम्प्रतिपूज्य in return honouring them, उवाच said.

40004900.author: Translation
40004900.content: Affectionate towards his relatives and friends, Bharata received all those gifts and in return honoured those messengers with things they liked, asking them:

40004901.author: पदार्थः
40004901.content: मम पिता my father, राजा दशरथः king Dasaratha, कच्चित् I hope, सकुशली doing well, रामे Rama, महात्मनि great, लक्ष्मणे च in Lakshmana also, अरोगता good health, कच्चित् I hope.

40004901.author: Translation
40004901.content: I hope my father, Dasaratha is doing well and revered Rama and Lakshmana are in good health

40004902.author: पदार्थः
40004902.content: आर्या च venerable lady indeed, धर्मनिरता devoted to righteousness, धर्मज्ञा adept in  righteousness, धर्मदर्शिनी observes the prescribed code of conduct, धीमतः sagacious, रामस्य Rama's, माता mother, कौशल्या Kausalya, अपि अरोगा is she keeping good health.

40004902.author: Translation
40004902.content: (I hope) Kausalya mother of the sagacious Rama the venerable lady devoted to righteousness one who knows the ways of righteousness and observes the prescribed code of conduct, is keeping sound  health.

40004903.author: पदार्थः
40004903.content: या that, धर्मज्ञा knowledgeable in the ways of righteousness, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, वीरस्य one who is full of valour, शत्रुघ्नस्य च Satrughna's, जननी mother, मध्यमा middle mother, सा सुमित्रापि that Sumitra, कच्चित् I hope, अरोगा is free from illness.

40004903.author: Translation
40004903.content: I hope my mother Sumitra (the middle one) who is familiar with the ways of righteousness, the mother of valiant Lakshmana and Satrughna, is enjoying good health.

40004904.author: पदार्थः
40004904.content: आत्मकामा ever intent on her welfare, सदा always, चण्डी irascible, क्रोधना wrathful, प्राज्ञमानिनी who is proud of her intelligence, मे माता my mother, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, अपि अरोगा is she free from illness, किम् what, उवाच ह did she say?

40004904.author: Translation
40004904.content: And what about my mother Kaikeyi, ever intent on her own wellbeing, wrathful, irascible and proud of her intelligence? Is she maintaining sound health?

40004905.author: पदार्थः
40004905.content: महात्मना magnanimous, भरतेन by Bharata, एवम् in this way, उक्ताः uttered, ते दूताः those messengers, तदा then, तं भरतम् addressing that Bharata, सप्रश्रयम् respectfully, इदं these  वाक्यम् (वचः) words, ऊचुः spoke.

40004905.author: Translation
40004905.content: Having listened to the words of that magnanimous Bharata, those messengers addressed him  gracefully with these words.

40004906.author: पदार्थः
40004906.content: नरव्याघ्र tiger among men (Bharata), येषाम् whose, कुशलम् welfare, इच्छसि you are  enquiring, ते they, कुशलाः are doing well, श्रीः prosperity, पद्मा goddess of wealth, त्वाम्  you, वृणुते chosen you, ते to you, रथः chariot, युज्यतां चापि may be yoked.

40004906.author: Translation
40004906.content: O tiger among men (Bharata) those of whose welfare you are enquiring are all doing well. May the goddess of wealth and prosperity await you and let your chariot be yoked.

40004907.author: पदार्थः
40004907.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः uttered, भरतश्चापि Bharata, तान् दूतान् to those messengers, अभ्यभाषत said, माम् me, दूताः messengers, सन्त्वरयन्ति are hastening me up, अहम् I, महाराजम् great king (of Kekaya), आपृच्छे shall seek permission to leave.

40004907.author: Translation
40004907.content: Having thus been addressed, Bharata said to the messengers. Let me seek the permission of the great king of Kekaya to leave and say goodbye, informing him that the messengers are hastening me up.

40004908.author: पदार्थः
40004908.content: दूतैः messengers, सञ्चोदितः having been pressed, पार्थिवात्मजः king's son, भरतः Bharata,  तान् दूतान् to those messengers, एवम् in the aforesaid manner, उक्त्वा having said, मातामहम् addressing maternal grandfather, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच ह said.

40004908.author: Translation
40004908.content: Having addressed the messengers who were pressing him to leave (for Ayodhya) Bharata said to his maternal grandfather:

40004909.author: पदार्थः
40004909.content: राजन् O king, दूतचोदितः urged by the messengers, पितुः father's, सकाशम् for, गमिष्यामि I shall go, त्वम् you, मे for me, यदा whenever, स्मरिष्यसि remember, पुनरपि again, अहं एष्यामि I shall come.

40004909.author: Translation
40004909.content: O king, urged by these messengers I wish to go to my father. I shall come back again (from Ayodhya) whenever you  remember me.

40004910.author: पदार्थः
40004910.content: तदा then, भरतेन by Bharata, एवम् thus, उक्तः urged, मातामहः the maternal grandfather, नृपः king (of Kekaya), तम् that, राघवम् to one of Raghu dynasty (Bharata), शिरसि on his head, आघ्राय having smelt, शुभम् auspicious, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke.

40004910.author: Translation
40004910.content: Then the  king of Kekaya, the maternal grandfather of Bharata, having heard the words of the scion of the Raghu dynasty (Bharata), kissed him on his forehead and spoke these auspicious words:

40004911.author: पदार्थः
40004911.content: तात O child, गच्छ you may go, त्वाम् you, अनुजाने I permit, त्वया by you, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, सुप्रजाः has a worthy son, परन्तप O slayer of enemies, मातरम् your mother, पितरं च and father, कुशलम् welfare, ब्रूयाः convey.

40004911.author: Translation
40004911.content: You may go, my child I permit you to leave. Kaikeyi has a worthy son in you. O slayer of enemies convey my best wishes to your mother and father.

40004912.author: पदार्थः
40004912.content: तात O child, पुरोहितम् to the family priest (Vasistha), अन्ये and others, ये द्विजसत्तमाः those illustrious brahmins, महेष्वासौ great bowmen (Rama and Lakshmana), कुशलम् best wishes, (ब्रूहि convey).

40004912.author: Translation
40004912.content: My child, convey my best wishes, too, to your family priest Vasistha and other illustrious brahmins and also to those two great bowmen (Rama and Lakshmana).

40004913.author: पदार्थः
40004913.content: कैकेयः king of Kekaya, तस्मै भरताय to that Bharata, हस्त्युत्तमान् wellbred elephants, चित्रान्  of manycoloured, कम्बलान् blankets, अजिनानि च antelope skins, धनम् riches, अभिसत्कृत्य  having felicitated, ददौ bestowed.

40004913.author: Translation
40004913.content: The king of Kekaya felicitated Bharata, out of affection and bestowed on him wellbred elephants, manycoloured blankets, antelope skins and riches.

40004914.author: पदार्थः
40004914.content: केकयः king of Kekaya, कैकयीपुत्रं son of Kaikeyi, सत्कृत्य having honoured, द्वे two, रुक्मनिष्कसहस्रे two thousand gold coins, षोडश अश्वशतानि च sixteen hundred  horses also, धनम् as wealth, आदिशत् bestowed.

40004914.author: Translation
40004914.content: King of Kekaya generously gave to the son of Kaikeyi (Bharata) in his honour two thousand gold coins and  sixteen hundred horses.

40004915.author: पदार्थः
40004915.content: तथा in the same way, अश्वपतिः Ashwapati, भरताय for Bharata, अभिप्रेतान् eamenable, विश्वास्यान् trustworthy men, गुणान्वितान् virtuous men, अमात्यान् counsellors, अनुयायिनः as companions, ददौ gave.

40004915.author: Translation
40004915.content: Similarly his maternal uncle Ashwapati quickly presented him amenable, trustworthy and virtuous counsellors as companions on his return journey.

40004916.author: पदार्थः
40004916.content: मातुलः maternal uncle, अस्मै for him (Bharata), ऐरावतान् born in Iravata mountain, ऐन्द्रशिरान्  born in Indrasira mountain, प्रियदर्शनान् beautiful to behold, नागान् elephants, शीघ्रान् swift moving, सुसंयुक्तान् welltrained, खरान् asses, धनम् riches, ददौ gave.

40004916.author: Translation
40004916.content: His maternal uncle gave him the wealth of goodlooking elephants born in Iravata and Indrasira mountains and swiftmoving and welltrained asses which can be yoked easily. He gave riches too.

40004917.author: पदार्थः
40004917.content: अन्तःपुरे in the inner apartment, अति संवृद्धान् wellraised, व्याघ्रवीर्यबलान्वितान् having the  strength and courage of tigers, दंष्ट्राऽऽयुधान् whose fangs are their weapons spears, महाकायान् of huge body, शुनश्च dogs also, उपायनम् as gift, ददौ gave.

40004917.author: Translation
40004917.content: He also gave him a gift of wellraised dogs of the inner apartment hugebodied with the strength and courage of tigers who used their fangs as weapons.

40004918.author: पदार्थः
40004918.content: तदा then, गमनत्वरया in a hurry to depart, सः that, कैकयीपुत्रः son of Kaikeyi, भरतः Bharata, केकयेन्द्रेण by the king of Kekaya, दत्तम् given, धनम् wealth, नाभ्यनन्दत did not delight him.

40004918.author: Translation
40004918.content: All the wealth given by the king of Kekaya did not delight Bharata, son of Kaikeyi who was in a hurry to depart for Ayodhya.

40004919.author: पदार्थः
40004919.content: दूतानाम् messengers', त्वरया चापि with the haste to depart, स्वप्नस्य dream's, दर्शनाच्चापि also due to beholding, तदा then, अस्य his, हृदये in the heart, सुमहती intense, चिन्ता anxiety, बभूव हि filled with.

40004919.author: Translation
40004919.content: Then his heart was filled with extreme anxiety due to the haste of the messengers to depart and also due to the dream he had.

40004920.author: पदार्थः
40004920.content: श्रीमान् prosperous, सः he (Bharata), नरनागाश्वसंवृतम् thronged with men, elephants and horses, सुमहत् great, स्ववेश्म his residence, अभ्यतिक्रम्य having passed by, अनुत्तमम् incomparable, राजमार्गम् royal highway, प्रपेदे obtained.

40004920.author: Translation
40004920.content: Prosperous Bharata on leaving his residence, passed through incomparable royal highway thronged with men, elephants and horses.

40004921.author: पदार्थः
40004921.content: उदारधीः nobleminded, अभ्यतीत्य having crossed, ततः thereafter, अन्तःपुरम् inner apartment, अपश्यत् saw, ततः then, श्रीमान् prosperous, भरतः Bharata, अनिवारितः without any restriction, तत् in that apartment, आविवेश entered.

40004921.author: Translation
40004921.content: Then the nobleminded, prosperous Bharata, on leaving the  highway, saw  the inner apartment of the king which he entered unhindered.

40004922.author: पदार्थः
40004922.content: सः भरतः that Bharata, मतामहम् maternal grandfather, मातुलम् uncle, युधाजितम् Yaddhajit, आपृच्छ्य taking leave, शत्रुघ्नसहितः along with Satrughna, रथम् chariot, आरुह्य having ascended, ययौ went.

40004922.author: Translation
40004922.content: Thus having taken leave of his maternal grandfather and uncle Yuddhajit, Bharata accompanied by Satrughna boarded the chariot and went along.

40004923.author: पदार्थः
40004923.content: भृत्याः servants, मण्डलचक्रांश्च of wellrounded wheels, परश्शतान् more than a hundred, रथान् chariots, योजयित्वा harnessing, उष्ट्रगोश्वबलैः with camels, oxen, and horses, यान्तम् going on, भरतम् Bharata, अन्ययुः followed.

40004923.author: Translation
40004923.content: And the servants harnessing more than a hundred chariots of wellrounded wheels and also camels, oxen and horses followed Bharata who started off.

40004924.author: पदार्थः
40004924.content: बलेन with army, गुप्तः under the protection of, महात्मा illustrious, अपेतशत्रुः devoid of enemies, भरतः Bharata, आत्मसमैः like himself, अमात्यैस्सह accompanied by ministers, शत्रुघ्नम् Satrughna, आदाय having taken, आर्यकस्य venerable grandfather's, गृहात् from house, सिद्ध: like siddha, इन्द्रलोकादिव from the regions of Indra, ययौ went.

40004924.author: Translation
40004924.content: Under the protection of the army, the illustrious Bharata who was devoid of enemies, accompanied by ministers who were comparable to him and Satrughna, departed from his venerable grandfather's house like a siddha leaving the regions of Indra. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्ततितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventieth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
